"""P08 probe: turn the supplier's own hedge letter against its 12-month alloy markup, ask for the owner's
calculation (call note), keep the accepted claims (PPI 3-month fall, forecast). Index clause 5% deadband, 36 m."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from plib import msg, ladder, should_close, their_sheet

CASE = "case:P08"
IDX = {"series": "AS-14404", "material_share": 0.45, "deadband_pct": 5, "base_month": "2026-08"}
TARGET = 5.12


def sheet(p):
    return {"unit_price": p, "index_clause": IDX, "payment_days": 30, "contract_months": 36}


def move(st):
    r = st["round"]
    if r > 1 and should_close(st, TARGET):
        return {"accept": their_sheet(st)[0]}
    if r == 1:
        body = (
            "Dear Mr Aigner,\n\n"
            "thank you for your letter of 12 September (doc:20260912-70710-P08). We agree with you: a 36-month term with "
            "your AS-14404 clause (45% share, August 2026 base) is the right basis, and we are ready to commit to it.\n\n"
            "One point on the base price. Your letter of 6 July (doc:20260706-70710-M1) told us that your nickel and alloy "
            "requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027 and that market movements reach your costs only after "
            "that. So the 5.9% twelve-month rise of AS-14404 has not reached your cost either - and from the August base "
            "the clause passes every later alloy move through to us. The alloy rise cannot also sit in the base price.\n\n"
            "Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, "
            "idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).\n"
            "Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).\n\n"
            "Your owner kindly offered to walk us through your calculation, hourly rates and material "
            "(doc:20260421-70710-M2); we would be glad to take him up on that.\n\n"
            "On this basis we propose EUR 4.95 per kg with the clause, 30 days, 36 months.\n\n"
            "Kind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing"
        )
        return msg("Round bar 1.4404 - price basis with your AS-14404 clause", body, [sheet(4.95)])
    p = ladder(st, 4.95, 0.3)
    body = (
        "Dear Mr Aigner,\n\nthank you for moving. With your alloy covered at fixed prices until March 2027 "
        "(doc:20260706-70710-M1) and the clause passing through every later move, the base price should carry no "
        f"alloy markup. We can move to EUR {p:.2f} per kg with the clause, 30 days, 36 months.\n\n"
        "Kind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing"
    )
    return msg("Re: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis", body, [sheet(p)])

case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis with your AS-14404 clause
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

thank you for your letter of 12 September (doc:20260912-70710-P08). We agree with you: a 36-month term with your AS-14404 clause (45% share, August 2026 base) is the right basis, and we are ready to commit to it.

One point on the base price. Your letter of 6 July (doc:20260706-70710-M1) told us that your nickel and alloy requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027 and that market movements reach your costs only after that. So the 5.9% twelve-month rise of AS-14404 has not reached your cost either - and from the August base the clause passes every later alloy move through to us. The alloy rise cannot also sit in the base price.

Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

Your owner kindly offered to walk us through your calculation, hourly rates and material (doc:20260421-70710-M2); we would be glad to take him up on that.

On this basis we propose EUR 4.95 per kg with the clause, 30 days, 36 months.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis with your AS-14404 clause
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Regarding our cost breakdown, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We agree to the 36-month term and the AS-14404 index clause, and have adjusted our base price to €5.59 per kg to reflect this structure and the recent PPI-C2431 data. Our present offer stands at a price of €5.59 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that our fixed-price coverage until March 2027 also means that any short-term falls in alloy costs do not reduce our expenses. Which volume can you commit to? 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

thank you for moving. With your alloy covered at fixed prices until March 2027 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) and the clause passing through every later move, the base price should carry no alloy markup. We can move to EUR 5.14 per kg with the clause, 30 days, 36 months.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your revised offer; however, our fixed-price coverage means that short-term falls in alloy costs do not reduce our expenses, which must remain reflected in the base price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

We are prepared to make a further concession and offer €5.49 per kg for the 36-month contract with the AS-14404 clause and 30 days payment. Our actual Angebot is a price of €5.49 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

To proceed, could you please confirm the exact volume you can commit to? Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
